root_cause: The bounded static localization build was correct but still translated batches sequentially. Netlify preview status exceeded the six-minute smoke-test window, so a structurally correct build could not meet delivery latency requirements.
prevention: Static translation batches should run through a bounded worker pool rather than purely sequential execution.
Concurrency must remain capped to protect provider rate limits and resource governance.
Recursive per-batch fallback remains authoritative when a concurrent batch fails.
The concurrency level must be configurable through STATIC_I18N_CONCURRENCY without requiring code changes.
evidence: GitHub Live Preview Smoke run 35689543690 timed out waiting six minutes for Netlify preview on head 6b02c4dc56811ddb75ed55bc1ca7688725995b3f
